# WAS_Verification { #wass2s.WAS_Verification }

```python
WAS_Verification(dist_method='nonparam', mae_rmse_crps_thrsd=100)
```

Verification class for evaluating weather and climate forecasts.

Provides methods to compute deterministic, probabilistic, and ensemble-based metrics,
as well as visualization tools for model performance assessment.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type   | Description                                                                                              | Default      |
|-------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| dist_method | str    | Distribution method for tercile probability calculations ('bestfit', 'nonparam'). Default is 'nonparam'. | `'nonparam'` |

### brier_score { #wass2s.WAS_Verification.brier_score }

```python
WAS_Verification.brier_score(
    y_true,
    y_probs,
    index_start,
    index_end,
    event='PA',
)
```

BS for a single tercile event (PB/PN/PA). y_probs has shape (3, N).

### brier_skill_score { #wass2s.WAS_Verification.brier_skill_score }

```python
WAS_Verification.brier_skill_score(
    y_true,
    y_probs,
    index_start,
    index_end,
    event='PA',
    reference='uniform',
)
```

Event-wise Brier Skill Score (BSS) for tercile forecasts.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                        | Description                                                                                        | Default                 |
|-------------|-----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| y_true      | 1D array-like               | Observed values (time series for one grid point).                                                  | _required_              |
| y_probs     | 2D array-like, shape (3, N) | Forecast probabilities for PB/PN/PA over time.                                                     | _required_              |
| index_start | int                         | Indices delimiting the calibration slice inside the *masked* series.                               | _required_              |
| index_end   | int                         | Indices delimiting the calibration slice inside the *masked* series.                               | _required_              |
| event       | (PB, PN, PA, 0, 1, 2)       | Event to score (default "PA" = above-normal).                                                      | `"PB","PN","PA",0,1,2`  |
| reference   | (uniform, empirical)        | - "uniform": climatology is [1/3,1/3,1/3] - "empirical": base rate computed from calibration slice | `"uniform","empirical"` |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                       |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------|
|        | float  | BSS = 1 - BS / BS_ref (np.nan if not computable). |

### calculate_groc { #wass2s.WAS_Verification.calculate_groc }

```python
WAS_Verification.calculate_groc(
    y_true,
    y_probs,
    index_start,
    index_end,
    n_classes=3,
)
```

Compute Generalized Discrimination (GROC) score according to Weigel and Mason (2011).

The GROC score averages the Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) for each category,
measuring the ability to distinguish occurrences from non-occurrences of each category.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type         | Description                                                   | Default    |
|-------------|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| y_true      | array - like | Observed values.                                              | _required_ |
| y_probs     | array - like | Forecast probabilities with shape (n_classes, n_samples).     | _required_ |
| index_start | int          | Start index of the climatology period for computing terciles. | _required_ |
| index_end   | int          | End index of the climatology period for computing terciles.   | _required_ |
| n_classes   | int          | Number of classes (default is 3 for terciles).                | `3`        |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                  |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | float  | GROC score, ranging from 0 to 1.  Returns np.nan if insufficient valid data. |

#### Reference {.doc-section .doc-section-reference}

Weigel, A. P. and Mason, S. J. (2011). 
The generalized discrimination score for ensemble forecasts.
Monthly Weather Review, 139(9):3069-3074.

### calculate_rpss_ { #wass2s.WAS_Verification.calculate_rpss_ }

```python
WAS_Verification.calculate_rpss_(y_true, y_probs)
```

Compute Ranked Probability Skill Score (RPSS) for a single grid point or sample.

Compares the Ranked Probability Score (RPS) of the forecast to a climatological
reference with uniform probabilities (1/3 for each tercile).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                               | Description                                                                                             | Default    |
|---------|------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| y_true  | array-like of shape (n_samples,)   | True class labels, already classified into terciles (0: below-normal, 1: near-normal, 2: above-normal). | _required_ |
| y_probs | array-like of shape (3, n_samples) | Forecast probabilities for each tercile category.                                                       | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                         |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | float  | RPSS score, ranging from -Inf to 1 (1 indicates perfect forecast skill). Returns np.nan if insufficient valid data. |

### calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit { #wass2s.WAS_Verification.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit }

```python
WAS_Verification.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit(
    best_guess,
    error_variance,
    T1,
    T2,
    dist_code,
    dof,
)
```

Generic tercile probabilities using best-fit family per grid cell.

Inputs (per grid cell):
- best_guess : 1D array over T (hindcast_det or forecast_det)
- T1, T2     : scalar terciles from climatological best-fit distribution
- dist_code  : int, as in _ppf_terciles_from_code
- shape, loc, scale : scalars from climatology fit

Strategy:
- For each time step, build a predictive distribution of the same family:
    * Use best_guess[t] to adjust mean / location;
    * Keep shape parameters from climatology.
- Then compute probabilities:
    P(B) = F(T1), P(N) = F(T2) - F(T1), P(A) = 1 - F(T2).

### compute_crps { #wass2s.WAS_Verification.compute_crps }

```python
WAS_Verification.compute_crps(y_true, y_pred, member_dim='number', dim='T')
```

Compute Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) for ensemble forecasts.

Measures the difference between the forecast ensemble distribution and observations.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type             | Description                                                      | Default    |
|------------|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| y_true     | xarray.DataArray | Observed data with dimensions (T, Y, X).                         | _required_ |
| y_pred     | xarray.DataArray | Ensemble forecast data with dimensions (T, number, Y, X).        | _required_ |
| member_dim | str              | Dimension name for ensemble members. Default is 'number'.        | `'number'` |
| dim        | str              | Dimension to compute CRPS over (typically time). Default is 'T'. | `'T'`      |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type             | Description                         |
|--------|------------------|-------------------------------------|
|        | xarray.DataArray | CRPS values with dimensions (Y, X). |

### compute_one_year_rpss_ { #wass2s.WAS_Verification.compute_one_year_rpss_ }

```python
WAS_Verification.compute_one_year_rpss_(
    obs,
    prob_pred,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
    year,
)
```

Compute and visualize the Ranked Probability Skill Score (RPSS) for a specific year.

Applies the RPSS calculation across a gridded dataset for a single year, using
tercile classifications based on a climatology period, and plots the results on a map.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type             | Description                                                                                                                                             | Default    |
|-----------------|------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| obs             | xarray.DataArray | Observed data with dimensions (T, Y, X), where T is time, Y is latitude, and X is longitude.                                                            | _required_ |
| prob_pred       | xarray.DataArray | Forecast probabilities with dimensions (probability, T, Y, X), where probability includes ['PB', 'PN', 'PA'] (below-normal, near-normal, above-normal). | _required_ |
| clim_year_start | int or str       | Start year of the climatology period for tercile classification.                                                                                        | _required_ |
| clim_year_end   | int or str       | End year of the climatology period for tercile classification.                                                                                          | _required_ |
| year            | int or str       | Specific year to compute the RPSS for.                                                                                                                  | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                      |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | None   | Displays a geographical plot of the RPSS values with a colorbar. |

| Name   | Type             | Description                          |
|--------|------------------|--------------------------------------|
|        | xarray.DataArray | Score values with dimensions (Y, X). |

### gcm_compute_prob { #wass2s.WAS_Verification.gcm_compute_prob }

```python
WAS_Verification.gcm_compute_prob(
    Predictant,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
    hindcast_det,
    best_code_da=None,
    best_shape_da=None,
    best_loc_da=None,
    best_scale_da=None,
)
```

Compute tercile probabilities for deterministic hindcasts.

If dist_method == 'bestfit':
    - Use cluster-based best-fit distributions to:
        * derive terciles analytically from (best_code_da, best_shape_da, best_loc_da, best_scale_da),
        * compute predictive probabilities using the same family.

Otherwise:
    - Use empirical terciles from Predictant climatology and the selected
      parametric / nonparametric method.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type             | Description                                                                       | Default    |
|-----------------|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| Predictant      | xarray.DataArray | Observed data (T, Y, X) or (T, Y, X, M).                                          | _required_ |
| clim_year_start | int or str       | Climatology period (inclusive) for thresholds.                                    | _required_ |
| clim_year_end   | int or str       | Climatology period (inclusive) for thresholds.                                    | _required_ |
| hindcast_det    | xarray.DataArray | Deterministic hindcast (T, Y, X).                                                 | _required_ |
| best_code_da    | xarray.DataArray | Output from WAS_TransformData.fit_best_distribution_grid, required for 'bestfit'. | `None`     |
| best_shape_da   | xarray.DataArray | Output from WAS_TransformData.fit_best_distribution_grid, required for 'bestfit'. | `None`     |
| best_loc_da     | xarray.DataArray | Output from WAS_TransformData.fit_best_distribution_grid, required for 'bestfit'. | `None`     |
| best_scale_da   | xarray.DataArray | Output from WAS_TransformData.fit_best_distribution_grid, required for 'bestfit'. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name          | Type             | Description                                                      |
|---------------|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
| hindcast_prob | xarray.DataArray | Probabilities with dims (probability=['PB','PN','PA'], T, Y, X). |

### gcm_validation_compute { #wass2s.WAS_Verification.gcm_validation_compute }

```python
WAS_Verification.gcm_validation_compute(
    models_files_path,
    Obs,
    score,
    month_of_initialization,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
    dir_to_save_roc_reliability,
    lead_time=None,
    ensemble_mean=None,
    gridded=True,
)
```

Validate multiple General Circulation Model (GCM) forecasts using specified metrics.

Computes deterministic, probabilistic, or ensemble-based scores for GCM hindcasts
by processing model data from provided file paths and comparing against observations.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                        | Type             | Description                                                                                                                                         | Default    |
|-----------------------------|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| models_files_path           | dict             | Dictionary mapping model identifiers (e.g., model names) to file paths of hindcast NetCDF files.                                                    | _required_ |
| Obs                         | xarray.DataArray | Observed data with dimensions (T, Y, X), where T is time, Y is latitude, and X is longitude.                                                        | _required_ |
| score                       | str              | Score to compute, must be a key in self.scores (e.g., 'Pearson', 'RPSS', 'ROC_CURVE', 'RELIABILITY_DIAGRAM').                                       | _required_ |
| month_of_initialization     | int              | Month of forecast initialization (1-12).                                                                                                            | _required_ |
| clim_year_start             | int or str       | Start year of the climatology period for computing tercile thresholds.                                                                              | _required_ |
| clim_year_end               | int or str       | End year of the climatology period for computing tercile thresholds.                                                                                | _required_ |
| dir_to_save_roc_reliability | str or Path      | Directory to save ROC curves and reliability diagram plots.                                                                                         | _required_ |
| lead_time                   | list of int      | Lead times in months to define the forecast season (e.g., [1, 2, 3] for a 3-month season). If None, no season is specified.                         | `None`     |
| ensemble_mean               | str              | Ensemble statistic to use for deterministic or probabilistic scores (e.g., 'mean'). If None, ensemble mean is computed automatically when required. | `None`     |
| gridded                     | bool             | Whether to perform gridded validation (True) or non-gridded (not implemented). Default is True.                                                     | `True`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|--------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict or None | If score_type is 'det_score', 'prob_score', or 'ensemble_score':     Dictionary with model identifiers as keys and xarray.DataArray of scores (dimensions Y, X) as values. If score_type is 'all_grid_prob_score' (e.g., ROC_CURVE, RELIABILITY_DIAGRAM):     None, as results are saved as plots. If score_type is 'all_grid_det_score':     None (not implemented). |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                                 |
|--------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | If the score is not recognized or if non-gridded validation is attempted (not implemented). |

| clim_year_end   | int or str       | End year of the climatology period.                                                          | _required_ |
| year            | int or str       | Specific year to compute the ratio for.                                                      | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                              |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | None   | Displays a geographical plot of the classified ratios with a custom colormap and legend. |

```python
    labels=None,
    title='Taylor diagram',
    figsize=(7, 6),
    savepath=None,
    hide_rms_numbers=True,
)
```

Plot a Taylor diagram comparing one or more model series against observations.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                        | Description                                                                   | Default                |
|-------------|---------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------|
| obs         | xarray.DataArray or np.ndarray              | Observations. If xarray, can be (T), (T,Y,X), etc.                            | _required_             |
| models      | dict\[str, xarray.DataArray \| np.ndarray\] | Mapping of model name -> forecast array (same shape as obs or broadcastable). | _required_             |
| normalize   | bool                                        | If True (default), normalize std and CRMSD by std(obs).                       | `True`                 |
| correlation | (pearson, spearman)                         | Correlation metric used on paired, finite values.                             | `"pearson","spearman"` |
| labels      | dict\[str, str\]                            | Custom display labels for model markers. Defaults to model keys.              | `None`                 |
| title       | str or None                                 | Figure title.                                                                 | `'Taylor diagram'`     |
| figsize     | tuple                                       | Matplotlib figure size.                                                       | `(7, 6)`               |
| savepath    | str or None                                 | If provided, save figure to this path.                                        | `None`                 |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                   | Description   |
|--------|----------------------------------------|---------------|
|        | (fig, ax) : matplotlib Figure and Axes |               |

### weibull_shape_solver { #wass2s.WAS_Verification.weibull_shape_solver }

```python
WAS_Verification.weibull_shape_solver(k, M, V)
```

Function to find the root of the Weibull shape parameter 'k'.
We find 'k' such that the theoretical variance/mean^2 ratio
matches the observed V/M^2 ratio.

### weighted_gcm_forecasts { #wass2s.WAS_Verification.weighted_gcm_forecasts }

```python
WAS_Verification.weighted_gcm_forecasts(
    Obs,
    best_models,
    scores,
    lead_time,
    model_dir,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
    variable='PRCP',
)
```

Generate weighted ensemble forecasts from selected GCMs based on their performance scores.

Combines hindcasts and forecasts from multiple models using weights derived from
the GROC score, scales the results to match observed climatology, and computes
tercile probabilities.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type             | Description                                                                               | Default    |
|-----------------|------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| Obs             | xarray.DataArray | Observed data with dimensions (T, Y, X), used for scaling and probability calculations.   | _required_ |
| best_models     | dict             | Dictionary of model identifiers (keys) to be included in the ensemble.                    | _required_ |
| scores          | dict             | Dictionary containing scores (e.g., GROC) for each model, with model identifiers as keys. | _required_ |
| lead_time       | list of int      | Lead times in months for the forecast season (e.g., [1, 2, 3] for a 3-month season).      | _required_ |
| model_dir       | str or Path      | Directory containing hindcast and forecast NetCDF files.                                  | _required_ |
| clim_year_start | int or str       | Start year of the climatology period for computing tercile thresholds.                    | _required_ |
| clim_year_end   | int or str       | End year of the climatology period for computing tercile thresholds.                      | _required_ |
| variable        | str              | Variable name in the NetCDF files (e.g., 'PRCP' for precipitation). Default is 'PRCP'.    | `'PRCP'`   |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | tuple  | - hindcast_det : xarray.DataArray     Weighted deterministic hindcast with dimensions (T, Y, X). - hindcast_prob : xarray.DataArray     Tercile probabilities for hindcasts with dimensions (probability, T, Y, X). - forecast_prob : xarray.DataArray     Tercile probabilities for forecasts with dimensions (probability, Y, X). |

#### Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

- Model files are expected to follow a naming convention like
  'hindcast_{center}_{variable}_{init_month}_{season}_{lead}.nc'.
- The GROC score is used as the weighting metric.
- A scaling factor is applied based on the ratio of observed to hindcast mean.
